sentences.en: Many people visited the shrine where the saint lay buried.
sentences.zh: 许多人都去圣人的墓前参观。

sentences.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
sentences.zh: 据说宝藏就埋藏在这一带。

sentences.en: To make a long story short, we buried the hatchet.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，我们冰释前嫌了。

senses.zh: 埋葬，葬,为…举行葬礼,隐藏，埋藏，遮盖，掩蔽,专心致志于，埋头于，沉溺于n.布里
